notes.title: 6/21/2018 patch notes
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30706722/425cf0982e29320f1f1360022b129d1ab239e32a.jpg[/img]
Hi everyone. As of today, we've finally finished optimizing the game. This includes the Mansion, which is the heaviest scene in the game, as well as all other smaller and medium-sized scenes which were not originally part of the optimization but we decided to include them as well. Improvements to the game are as follows:

1. Reduced the game's file size from 18GB to 10.6GB, a reduction of about 40%.
2. Reduced RAM usage by approximately 40% when accessing the Village scene.
3. Reduced RAM usage by approximately 30% when accessing Mansion and Hospital scenes.
4. Improved Unity's batching process by about 40%, which is the number of files needed to be read by the CPU, especially when accessing the Mansion and Hospital.
5. Improved load times when switching between scenes during gameplay.
6. Improved prop textures for some locations.
7. Lowered the system requirements to run the game (as shown below).

MINIMUM (updated):
OS: Windows 7/8/10 64-bit
Processor: i3-2120 @3.3GHz
Memory: 8 GB RAM
Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 745 (or AMD equivalent)
DirectX: Version 11
Storage: 11 GB available space
Additional Notes: *Subject to change after updates

RECOMMENDED (updated):
OS: Windows 7/8/10 64-bit
Processor: i5-2500 @3.3GHz
Memory: 8 GB RAM
Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 770 (or AMD equivalent)
DirectX: Version 12
Storage: 11 GB available space
Additional Notes: SSD for faster loading time 
*Subject to change after updates

Disclaimer on system requirements:
We have updated our minimum and recommended specs so the game can gaming PCs with moderate (or even slightly lower) specs. However, you may face small freezes when exploring the Village scene. This is due to the way the game now loads only necessary props and unloads the rest. Although some players might find this slightly jarring, we feel it is a necessary trade off to improve the overall loading times. If the game is installed on an SSD, this issue should be non-existent.

Since releasing the game on September 2017, we spent nine months fixing the bugs and optimizing the game. During this time period, we learned a lot about game optimization in general and the Unity game engine. We also stumbled upon an amazing community with mature and helpful players, and are extremely grateful for their patience, help and support. Now that The Painscreek Killings is officially done, the next thing on our list are localization, console and VR ports. We've never attempted them before and thus do not have a set release date yet. However, we will make effort to accomplish them within the shortest time possible. In the meantime, you can follow us on our blog, Facebook or Twitter for more updates and information!

http://eqstudios.blogspot.com/
https://www.facebook.com/EQSLV/
https://twitter.com/EQSLV
http://eqstudios.com/

notes.title: 5/31/2018 patch notes
notes.notes:
Hi everyone. We've finished optimizing the Hospital, which is the second heaviest scene in the game, and revamped textures for a number of props. Improvements when accessing the Hospital are as follows:

1. Reduced Hospital loading time.
2. Reduced RAM usage.
3. Slightly reduced GPU usage.

We are currently working on the Mansion, which is probably the heaviest scene in the game, followed by a full game optimization shortly after. Once that's done, the game should run much better. More information on that later.


Hot Fix 1:
Some users were having issues on loading into the game after the latest patch. The problem was hunted down and the game should be stable now. We're sorry for any inconveniences this may have caused.
We're going to be doing an additional fix very soon to patch another small problem.

Hot Fix 2(June 1, 2018):
Certain UV maps had some issues. These were sorted out.
Some objects were missing their colliders, and others were accidentally made hidden. All of these have been fixed. 

Hot Fix 3(June 13, 2018):
Fixed an issue where players would accidentally find several copies of the Inn's Room 203 Key. 
Footsteps audio bug has been patched.
Oliver's Photolab is now fully optimized.
Oliver's Photolab was using an old prefab for the character, causing people to freeze. This has been fixed.

Hot Fix 4(June 14, 2018)
Small Texture problem fixed.

Hot Fix 5(June 15, 2018)
Room 203's proper key is now fixed and can be interacted with.
There was a missing cabinet in Trisha's Room...we found it had warped to the roof. This has been fixed.
Johnson's letter in his desk has been placed back in it's place.

Hot Fix 6(June 16, 2018)
Andrew's House has been optimized. 
The Inn has been optimized.
There was an extra journal in the Sheriff's outpost, we've removed that one.
There's been a few texture fixes.
A few drawers/cabinets have been fixed and can now be opened.
We've reduced the game file size.

notes.title: 5/9/2018 patch notes
notes.notes:
Hi everyone. Here’s a list of things that were patched/implemented:

1. Optimized the village, one of the three heaviest scenes in the game. This includes optimizing the terrain and improving the terrain textures, which helps with reducing the RAM and GPU usage, and the loading times,.

2. Proof-read all documents (U.S. English).

3. Updated the disclaimer at the beginning of the game, informing players of the reload option should they encounter technical issues during gameplay.

4. Fixed incorrect dates which caused inconsistencies in the story's timeline.

5. Minor bugs fixes listed by players posted in the Steam community forum.

6. Removed AA option since the game uses Unity 5.3.4 engine which does not support that feature.

7. Implemented full Steam Controller support.

8. Made changes towards the end of the game to improve the player's experience during gameplay.

We thank the community for their support and being patient with us. Currently, we are working hard at optimizing the Hospital and the Mansion, which are the remaining heaviest scenes in the game. Upon completion, the game's frame rate and loading time should improve considerably.

notes.title: 2/16/2018 patch notes
notes.notes:
Here’s a list of things that were patched/implemented:

1. Implemented a Reload button in the pause menu for players who fell through the world or got stuck behind furniture. It has a wait time of 2 minutes, after which the player will respawn to the entrance of the location. Any items picked up prior to this and photos taken will still be in your possession.

2. Implemented FOV slider in the video options.

3. Dirt lense removed.

The following were part of the demo, but implemented in the paid version as well: 

4. New props were added to some locations and a few items were shifted around to accommodate a better experience for new players.

5. Additional audio content were added to a few key locations that gives reason for players to visit certain locations.

6. About 25% of the game content received proof-reading and grammar check.

7. Players can continue their save game from the demo version to the paid version so they do not have to replay the beginning part again.

We understand that some players are still affected by the low frame rate, long loading time and game crashes. We have recently found out the problem and are in the process of fixing it. Unfortunately, it’s an issue that needs quite some time to fix. We will post updates on its progress from time to time.

notes.notes:
Here’s a list of things that were patched/implemented:

1. Removed the bounce light effect from player’s flashlight to avoid frame rate drop issue.

2. Implemented 4K resolution as an option (no 4K textures included at this point).

3. Fixed a few lines in the Steam achievement script.

Note: This is probably the last patch for this year. We still have quite a number of things to do for 2018, such as controller implementation, localization, and a few others which we will disclose as the time nears. We are grateful for the community support and feedback, and hope to provide a better gaming experience for our current players and any detective mystery fan. Till then, we wish everyone a Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year! :)

notes.title: 12/20/2017 patch notes
notes.notes:
Here's a list of things that were patched/implemented:

1. Optimized the Mansion and Hospital scenes to have better frame rates. We replaced the Unity terrain and grass in those scenes with 3D mesh. High-res textures were removed and replaced with slightly lower-res textures without affecting the atmosphere/look of the game. 

2. Improved loading speed when switching between scenes during gameplay.

3. Fixed game bugs that resulted from the optimizing process.

4. Fixed game content with incorrect info.

5. Inserted a delay in-between background music to avoid constant repetition.

6. Fixed the Steam achievements. Players who achieved 'Completionist' will also unlock 'Truth Revealed'. For players who want to unlock 'You're Fired' achievement, you will have to start a new game. Be sure to back up the saveData.txt file before starting over if you'd like to keep your current save data.

We are currently working hard on controller implementation. Unfortunately, there were issues regarding the overall feel of it and not having enough buttons to integrate all game actions, and it's taking more time than we expected. We hope to remedy the issues soon.

notes.title: Optimization patch coming soon! Plus, announcing 'The Making of The Painscreek Killings' blog series
notes.notes:
We are currently in the final stages of optimization and will be releasing a patch for it soon. In the meantime, join us on our blog as we talk about the making of The Painscreek Killings, illustrating the problems we faced, the breakthroughs we had, and how it developed from an idea to a finished product. We hope it can benefit anyone currently developing a murder mystery detective game similar to ours, or a story-based walking simulator in general.

https://eqstudios.blogspot.com/

notes.title: 10/30/2017 patch notes.
notes.notes:
Here a list of things that were patched/implemented:

1. Fixed a bug where keybinds were not recognized.

2. Re-scripted the way scenes are loaded/unloaded to reduce RAM strain. This should prevent PCs with 8GB RAM from crashing when loading between heavy scenes.

We are currently hard at work with asset optimization, namely the Hospital and Mansion scenes. We are also cleaning our scripts to reduce garbage collection and memory leaks. Kindly bear with us as we try to make the game experience better for our players.

Note: Regarding the Steam Achievements, some of them are still buggy and are being looked at. However, the ending achievements should now be unlockable.

notes.title: 10/8/2017 patch notes.
notes.notes:
Here a list of things that were patched/implemented:

1. Fixed Hospital's light switch bug which, when accessed, caused the power unit to malfunction.

2. Fixed incorrect date of birth on Vivian's tombstone.

3. Removed a metal blue cabinet inside Oliver's Photo Lab which created collision problem for some players, causing them to be 'pushed off' and fall off the game world.

Note: To rectify issue #3, we tried to implement 'safety nets' in all scenes so players who fell off the game world will be moved to the starting point of that scene. Unfortunately, it caused more problems, such as not being able to go down the well and having the message in the sewer that said "We are sorry that you encountered a game breaking bug" despite the game still running fine. In the end, we removed all the 'safety nets'. 

For anyone who falls off the game world, simply select 'Quit' (do NOT select 'Save and quit'). Then start the game again and everything will be fine. Should you accidentally click on 'Save and quit', just let us know and we will help remedy your situation.

notes.title: 10/5/2017 patch notes.
notes.notes:
Here a list of things that were patched/implemented:

1. A few typos found in some diaries.

2. A bug that some players encountered with doors that are locked from the other side.

3. Depth-of-field is now disabled with a new install. For existing players, you can disable it in the options menu if you prefer not to have the 'blurry' effect.

4. Bloom can now be toggled on or off in the options menu.

5. Added 2560 x 1440 resolution.

Note: We are still in the process of optimizing the game and unfortunately, will take awhile. We did remove unused and hidden assets which, when tested on our slower computer, led to improved loading time between the game’s heavier scenes, and slightly better frame rate for the Hospital. We cannot guarantee these improvements for everyone, but for those who do, we hope it presents you with a better gaming experience.

notes.title: 10/1/2017 patch notes.
notes.notes:
We noticed some bugs that's causing some problems for our players. Although not game breaking, the bugs nevertheless take away from the immersion and experience. Here's what we did:

1. Fixed the clock safe puzzle which caused an issue when the hour hand is rotated one round or more.

2. Fixed road signs with wrong street names.

3. Fixed the newspaper pertaining to Dr. Henry Johnson which has the wrong published date.

4. Removed trowel from the Mansion garage which was accidentally placed.

We did notice that some players are encountering the black screen bug at the end of the game. This is a problem as players won't know how they fared in their investigation. We are not sure why that's happening at the moment and are looking into it. We appreciate your patience.

notes.notes: We just found out that the 'grades' were not showing at the end of the game, causing the game to show a black screen instead of advancing to the main menu. We have since fixed the problem, and apologize for any inconvenience caused.
